messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a short 'tactile onboarding health' sprint to prep for next week's QBR/EBR. Goal: confirm slide owners, validate demo fallbacks, and capture any renewal risk flags. Please scan the deck and volunteer slices you own.

liam_am: Thanks — can you drop the link? I'll take the renewal risks slide if no one else has it.

maria_cs: Deck is here: https://redwood-co.slides/quarterly/tactile-onboard-v1 (edit access for CS leads). Renewal risks = taken by @liam_am :thumbsup:

sophie_csm: I'll own onboarding health metrics + activation funnel slide. Quick ask: can someone run a smoke test of the live demo flows tomorrow? Need to confirm token limits and a fallback text-only example.

jordan_eng: I can run the smoke test tomorrow 10am PT. What exactly should I verify?

maria_cs: Thanks Jordan. Checklist: 1) demo seeds load without model timeouts, 2) fallback to smaller model returns within 500ms, 3) recording of logs to the console bucket, 4) confirm feature flags for private deployment customers are off by default. Paste results back here.

priya_pm: For exec alignment, we should include a 1-slide contingency plan: if latency > SLO, show canary to a cheaper region + manual rollback steps. I can draft the contingency blurb.

liam_am: On renewal risks — quick note: two accounts showing 2-week activation lag. I've added notes in the deck speaker notes. We should surface to AEs before the QBR.

sophie_csm: Also adding engagement quotes from product usage — 2 customers called out latency on long-context loads. Might be related to sequence length config.

jordan_eng: For the smoke test I'll run these commands on staging: 
```
# run demo seed
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"demo seed","max_tokens":128}'
# fallback test to small model
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate?model=redwood-mini -d '{"prompt":"demo seed","max_tokens":64}'
```
Will paste outputs.

ops-bot: Recording created: https://redwood-ops.rec/rec-2026-03-25-10am (Jordan scheduled smoke test)

maria_cs: Great. Action items: 
- Jordan: smoke test + logs (due: tomorrow 12pm PT)
- Sophie: finalize onboarding metrics slide (due: EOD today)
- Liam: prep renewal risk write-up and AE heads-up (due: EOD today)
- Priya: contingency slide draft (due: tomorrow morning)
I'll consolidate edits and do a dry run Fri 9am PT.

liam_am: Noted. I'll ping AEs after my write-up. Can we add a one-liner about crediting dedicated capacity discounts in renewal convo? Helps negotiation.

maria_cs: Yes add to the renewal notes area under 'commercial levers'.

sophie_csm: Added metric visual + 2 callouts about long-context issues. Need a quick blurb from Eng on expected mitigation timeline for customers asking about sequence-length improvements.

jordan_eng: Short blurb: multi-step rollout — short-term: quantization profile + batching (2–3 weeks), medium: kernel improvements (6–8 weeks). I'll add to speaker notes.

priya_pm: For the exec readout slide, I'd like a 3-bullet ask: 1) approve a prioritized onboarding sprint, 2) allocate 20% runway for Dedicated discounts, 3) greenlight an ops smoke-test cadence for demos. Does that work?

maria_cs: Perfect. One more thing — capture feedback during QBR via this Google Form (responses go to CS ops): https://forms.redwood/ebr-feedback. Sophie, add link to the last slide.

sophie_csm: Done. Also added a 'demo fallback' screenshot and a short script in the notes to run if demo fails.

liam_am: Quick ask — can we record who will present each slide in the deck metadata? helps for dry run.

maria_cs: Yes I'll tag slide owners in the deck and create a 30-min dry run calendar invite for Fri 9–9:30am PT.

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent to: maria_cs, liam_am, sophie_csm, jordan_eng, priya_pm

maria_cs: Thanks team — if anyone spots a blocker, drop it here. Otherwise I'll roll the consolidated deck by EOD. :rocket:
